verdict.description: What the matcher's answer (matcher_col_id) is to this Red List species

col_id.description: The CoL record (usage id) whose name is this Red List species: matcher_col_id when the matcher is right (same species or lumped); another record's id when it is a different species and a right record exists; null when not in CoL or unsure

reasoning.description: Three to five sentences: the facts that decided it (authors, years, family, where each lives) and the source of each
